summary.en: The RSF has intensified drone strikes, cutting power across southeast Sudan and targeting markets and hospitals, killing civilians and limiting medical care. The UK has imposed sanctions on Sudanese military leaders linked to a campaign of rape in El Fasher. The UAE’s involvement is criticised as contributing bloodshed, while refugees who fled Darfur now see their children growing up in the same camp. Gold miners face dangerous, laborious conditions, and humanitarian aid remains limited. 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: RSF-militsen har økt droneangrep, kutter strøm i sør-øst Sudan og rammer markeder og sykehus, dreper sivile og begrenser helsehjelp. Storbritannia har innført sanksjoner mot sudanske militære ledere knyttet til en voldtekampanje i El Fasher. De forente arabiske emiraters rolle kritiseres for å bidra til blodbad, mens flyktninger som flyktet fra Darfur nå ser barna sine vokse opp i samme leir. Gullgruvearbeidere møter farlige, arbeidskrevende forhold, og humanitær hjelp er fortsatt begrenset. 4 680 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Sudanese civil war (2023–present)
background.extract: Since April 2023, there has been a civil war in Sudan between the two main factions of the country's military government. The conflict involves the internationally recognized government of Sudan led by the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF), under General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan; against the rival Government of Peace and Unity led by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) paramilitary group, commanded by General Hemedti. Smaller armed groups have also taken part on both sides, most notably Sudan Liberation Movement splinter groups, the Tamazuj militia, and the Darfur Joint Protection Force.
background.extractNb: Konflikten i Sudan 2023 er en pågående væpnet konflikt mellom rivaliserende fraksjoner i Sudans regjering som brøt ut den 15. april 2023 over hele landet. Konflikten er hovedsakelig i hovedstaden Khartoum og i Darfurregionen.
